notes.title: Remaster is out!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey everyone![/h1][p][/p][p]The remaster is finally complete! With reservations for potential glitch patching in the future, but it's otherwise fully complete now.  Thanks to the support from everyone that bought the original game! Your feedback helped me make this remaster possible.  [/p][p][/p][p]The remaster comes with new content such as:[/p][p][/p][p]- Gothfair and Snowfox Valley expanded a little [/p][p]- Several new islands to explore [/p][p]- A new treasure map quest, a love trail quest (requires Letha and Yoni to be married), and more [/p][p]- Defend the fortress mission added to the Port Commercia fortress after Cupide has been defeated[/p][p][/p][p]The remaster also includes:[/p][p][/p][p]- Improved turn-based combat system, now more standard rather than the basic engine system
[/p][p]- Overhaul of many skills, including Letha and Yoni each having one ultimate skill each. The ultimate skills and some other skills are stronger than before, but now requires some stamina to activate

- A nemesis-ish system including random events (selected at random at the start of a new playthrough), options to kill or spare other masters and consequences, both positive and negative, from such choices[/p][p][/p][p]- Some new weapons and ship skins you can select (talk to Samuel to see the list of skins)[/p][p][/p][p]Other improvements:[/p][p][/p][p]- More visually appealing UI and text font[/p][p]- Character images for Letha and Yoni used more often and now look a bit sharper than in the original[/p][p]- Some minor glitches and typos fixed[/p][p]- While Yoni is in the party, press Q to open a social menu. You can ask for her opinion about the map you are currently in, or select random chatter to get a random dialogue between Letha and Yoni[/p][p][/p][p]It would be super appreciated if you would like to leave feedback if you find something I missed to fix during testing. And it would also mean a lot to see reviews for the remaster. Thanks! ReeneOK

As for the original, yes it will stay up! It may get an update in the future, just to get some minor improvements. No overhauls like in the remaster, but small fixes.

You can find the remaster here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688030/Trials_of_Proelium_Remastered/"]Remaster store page[/url][/p]

notes.title: Trials of Proelium is getting remastered
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey emperors![/h1]

Trials of Proelium is getting a remastered version. This game was the first one I ever published as a product and I have learned a lot more since then. At first I considered just upgrading the UI and stuff, but over time, the list of changes and improvements became so large I figured I'd make a new game entirely out of it.

The remaster will improve the weakest parts of the original title as well as adding and building upon existing mechanics. A lot of the improvements are based on your feedback for the original title, so thanks for your support!

[h2]Some of the major improvements you can expect in the remaster:[/h2]

-Improved art and visuals, including UI design, text font and character portraits

-Better combat system and skill trees, including a moon dancer skill tree for Yoni, while still keeping a lot of the spells from the original game

-Random events that can make each play-through different. This can be unique NPC encounters, other masters sending out goons to kill you and other things. The game will essentially pick a random number when you start a new game, each number containing a list of these random events

-Other masters can now be killed or spared, both options having potential consequences

-Some dialogue improvements and glitch fixes

-Skin customization options for your ship

-Some new mechanics and more content

-And more!

[h2]Sounds interesting?[/h2]
Wishlist it here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688030/Trials_of_Proelium_Remastered/]Trials of Proelium Remastered[/url]

notes.title: Trials of Proelium V3
notes.notes:
Version 3 is now out for Trials of Proelium. It fixes several issues and improves the overall gameplay performance.

[h1]Battles:[/h1]

- Going to a boss with four characters and using three or more summons by either waiting a long time for the cooldown or using the initialize spell could cause  the game to crash. To avoid going over the character limit, the following things have been changed:

1: Each character can only use one summon per battle (Letha's clone skill + a Yoni summon)
2: Removed cooldowns for all summon spells and instead locks them once a summon has been spawned. Summon spells are unlocked when a battle is over (by winning or escaping)

- You can now see current health and status for all characters in your party, even if you go beyond four members

- Sacratus can, in some instances, arrogantly revive players only to then ask why they are still alive. He can still arrogantly revive players, but his dialogue has been changed to make more sense now in case players encountered this specific flaw

[h1]Maps:[/h1]

- Fixed a very situation specific glitch that made it impossible to go to Silverbay jungle after all the academy quests were completed, but the Veneficus boss fight had not begun yet

- Fixed a situation specific glitch causing Amos to sometimes become invisible during the double date quest

- Fixed a couple of minor tileset issues in a couple maps

- Adjusted information for Golden beach to say the recommended level is 10+ instead of 1+, since the only enemy there can easily kill players going to the Golden beach too early

[h1]Etc:[/h1]

- Added option to change message speed for those that rather want text to appear instantly

- Removed "buffs" from Lexy since she doesn't have any buff spells

- Minor consistency adjustments so all items at the fairy trader costs no gold and one token

- Asteroid quest item is now a key item as it should be

- Slight adjustments to make things more clear. Like Extasis seal skill (it's meant to only seal physical skills but not magic. I changed the spell to say "Physical Seal" rather than just "Seal")

notes.title: V2.0 update
notes.notes:
This is a rather big update fixing various small issues and balancing skills. I would like to thank everyone who reported issues! Some of the changes may only take place when you start a new game.

[h1]Glitches:[/h1]

- Got rid of the rock in the Snowfox Valley dungeon. Players should no longer potentially get stuck

- Asking Yoni to marry you inside a restaurant and saying "No" when game asked if you're sure would cause players to get stuck. This should no longer be the case

- Fixed various small tileset issues (being able to walk where you shouldn't be able to)

- Fixed an issue causing footstep SE to disappear at some instances when it shouldn't

- Fixed an issue causing Golden beach to still be "undiscovered" and a dialogue to repeat over and over again if players did the Space bending side quest objectives in a certain order

 - Fixed an issue causing Letha to join the party inside the mage academy if players went out on one of the academy balconies 

- Fixed an issue with the Snowfox Valley weapon trader not working properly before doing the Moth side quest

[h1]Skill changes:[/h1]

- Increased the likelyhood of certain skill effects to apply on enemies

- Increased damage of some LUK based skills for Letha

- Increased damage and likelyhood of applying decay for Samuel's Sting skill to make it more viable

- Bond spell now costs MP as it should

- Fairy's heal all spell now costs MP as it should

- Increased Fairy summon's starting MP

- Letha's summon clone skill incorrectly said clone cannot level up. Clone can level up and its HP and EXP gain has been adjusted to not be overpowered

[h1]Minor changes:[/h1]

- Rotated chest at Gothfair outskirts map, as it could be opened from below the cliff

- Fixed a couple typos 

- Made wedding rings impossible to discard, as it made no sense to get engaged with Yoni and then drop the rings

- Changed Slot Scroll to a new Endurance Scroll instead, as Slot Scroll wasn't working as it should anyway. The new scroll has also been added to Gachapon

- Added scroll rewards when defeating Phaedra. She had no proper reward earlier besides EXP
